recon.notes: AAP National Conference & Exhibition is a single annual flagship conference with multiple future instances (2026-2029). Main listing page (aapexperience.org/future-dates/) shows upcoming conference dates/venues; detailed session schedules hosted on EventScribe platform (aapexperience26.eventscribe.net) behind Cloudflare protection. WordPress-based main portal.

Single flagship conference: Aesthetic & Anti-Aging Medicine World Congress 2027 in Cannes. Built with Next.js (SPA requiring client-side rendering). Informa-owned property. Metadata confirms 2027 event date via og:image.

BAD Annual Meeting 2027 hosted at separate domain badannualmeeting.co.uk (WordPress). Main bad.org.uk site has /events-content page but it's a Next.js SPA with no server-rendered event content. One confirmed upcoming conference: BAD 2027 Liverpool, 29 June - 1 July 2027.

Homepage navigation links to /meetings/forthcoming-meetings/ which displays the 53rd Annual Meeting (8-10 December 2026) with full event details in a multi-tab EventsForce portal (tabs: Welcome, Important Dates, Programme, Registration, Abstracts, Social Events, Exhibitors/Sponsors, Industry Programme, Venue, Travel, Accommodation, FAQs). Static Bootstrap HTML site with no JavaScript requirement or bot protection encountered.

Single-flagship-conference site (Digital Health Rewired 2027, 16-17 March 2027, Birmingham NEC). Powered by ASP.events SHOWOFF platform. Homepage has structured event data with dates. A /programme page exists for session details but content is JS-rendered.

ACR Convergence is a single flagship annual conference with its own dedicated detail page. The site is a Next.js SPA requiring client-side rendering. Upcoming event dates (2026-2027) found in page content.

Flagship annual medical conference. Site is SPA-based requiring JS. ATS 2026 (abstract deadline Nov 4, 2026) and ATS 2027 (New Orleans, proposal deadline Oct 14, 2026) confirmed with dated content visible.

Found during wave 2d: the EULAR Annual Congress (Berlin, June 2027) lives on congress.eular.org, not eular.org/event (source 134 covers eular.org events). ColdFusion .cfm pages likely (registration.cfm). Confirm the dated home page, registration fees and abstract key dates.

BCS hosts its flagship 2027 Annual Conference internally and manages training courses through EventsAir registrar (eventsair.site). Main /courses/ listing page at /courses/ shows multiple upcoming dated courses (e.g. National Training Day 2026-09-23, Year in Cardiology 2026-12-11) with venue info inline; clicking events links to external EventsAir registration pages. Annual conference information on dedicated /annual-conference/ page referencing Manchester Central 2027 event. WordPress-based main site with content-rich navigation.

NHS England events portal (events.england.nhs.uk subdomain) with integrated ticketing system. Events show full details on event page: date, time, location, organizer info. Workforce education events confirmed including NHS College of Leadership and Management workshops. Pagination via query params (?page=2). Built by Sigma Technology, uses Materialize CSS framework.

Custom SPA with Algolia search. Events (IMCAS China 2026 27-29 Aug, IMCAS World 2027 28-30 Jan, IMCAS Americas 2027 20-22 May, IMCAS Asia 2027 4-6 Jun, INVEST by IMCAS 2027) rendered server-side in HTML with module-based JS client. Individual congress pages carry details and side-events. No auth wall. Status 200, clean fetch.

ORS maintains a Tockify-embedded calendar at /events/ (requires JS to render) alongside individual event pages for flagship conferences. Confirmed 2027 Annual Meeting (Feb 19-23, 2027) and multiple symposia with future dates. WordPress site with static event pages + dynamic calendar.
